init.title: Connection settings
init.description: Some lamps and ESP32 Bluetooth proxies drop an idle connection, which makes the next command lag while the integration reconnects. Keep-alive pings the lamp periodically so the link stays up, and reconnects straight away if it drops. Note that a permanent connection occupies one of your Bluetooth proxy's connection slots.

data_description.keep_alive: Periodically ping the lamp so the Bluetooth connection is not dropped for being idle.
data_description.keep_alive_interval: Seconds between pings. Lower values keep the link more reliably at the cost of a little more Bluetooth traffic.
